description: This file defines various classes for different prompt styles used in language model interactions, including abstract base class and specific implementations like llama2, llama3, tag, mistral, and chatml. It also includes a factory function to select prompt styles based on a string identifier.

classes.name: AbstractPromptStyle
classes.description: Abstract base class for different prompt formatting styles.

classes.name: DefaultPromptStyle
classes.description: Default prompt style that passes empty strings, indicating default behavior.

classes.name: Llama2PromptStyle
classes.description: Prompt style inspired by Llama 2, formatting messages with specific tags and structure.

classes.name: Llama3PromptStyle
classes.description: Prompt style for Meta's Llama 3.1, using specific tags and message formatting.

classes.name: TagPromptStyle
classes.description: Prompt style using <|ROLE|> tags for message roles.

classes.name: MistralPromptStyle
classes.description: Prompt style for Mistral, using <s> and <inst> tags.

classes.name: ChatMLPromptStyle
classes.description: Prompt style following ChatML format with specific start and end tokens.

methods.name: get_prompt_style
methods.description: Factory function to instantiate a prompt style class based on a string identifier.
